answer: Admission auctions price the inlet: each epoch opens 40 slots; the top 40 deposit bids win a quartz token. Deposits sit in escrow; a marble ledger lists every bid. Faking 100 identities means outbidding honest agents 100 times: at 50 POA a slot, 5,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 50 POA and earns it back. Caught cheaters forfeit deposits; honest agents recover theirs plus slashed funds, so honesty is cheap and fakery loses money.
